attributes.label: Technology

attributes.label: Project size

attributes.label: Livestock species

attributes.label: Agricultural residues
attributes.requirement: Published residue quantities or explicitly published residue estimates by municipality with units and method; crop area alone is not residue quantity.

attributes.label: Crop

attributes.label: Municipality
attributes.requirement: Municipality identifiers associated with both branches; provincial totals alone do not satisfy the municipal request.

attributes.label: Reference year
attributes.requirement: Year associated with livestock and residue observations, with differing reference years stated.

attributes.label: Biomethane injection capacity
attributes.requirement: Published receiving/injection capacity for biomethane with units, time basis and technical conditions.

attributes.label: Zone or connection point
attributes.requirement: Identifiable gas-network zone or connection point associated with the capacity; preserve the level actually published.

attributes.label: Latest available data

topics.question: Where can I get rural land prices or rural land transactions in {country}, by municipality or region and year?

attributes.label: Rural land price
attributes.requirement: Published rural-land price values with currency, area/unit and statistical/transaction basis; offers and assessments must remain distinguished.

attributes.label: Rural land transactions
attributes.requirement: Published records or series of rural-land transfers, stating whether individual prices or only aggregates are available; counts alone do not establish price coverage.

attributes.label: Municipality or region
attributes.requirement: Published municipality/region associated with prices or transactions, with territorial identifiers and level stated.

attributes.label: Reference year
attributes.requirement: Year associated with the price/transaction observation, not merely the publication date.

attributes.label: Latest available data
attributes.requirement: Identify the latest value, record set or legal version made available for the requested subject, with its reference date and any publication lag.

topics.question: Where can I get the locations of known mineral deposits and occurrences in {country}, with commodity, size or grade, and status (explored, mined, abandoned)?

attributes.label: Deposit or occurrence location
attributes.requirement: Location of identifiable mineral deposits/occurrences, with spatial precision and record type stated.

attributes.label: Commodity
attributes.requirement: Mineral/commodity associated with each deposit or occurrence.

attributes.label: Deposit size
attributes.requirement: Published size/tonnage/resource measure with units, category and reference basis; annual production alone is different.

attributes.label: Grade
attributes.requirement: Published grade/concentration with units and sample/resource basis; do not infer deposit grade from commodity presence.

attributes.label: Status
attributes.requirement: Published explored, mined, abandoned or other documented deposit/occurrence state.

topics.question: Where can I get mining rights in {country} (exploration permits and mining concessions) as geometry, with holder, commodity, status and dates?

attributes.label: Mining-right geometry
attributes.requirement: Polygon geometry per exploration permit or mining concession, distinguishing rights from extraction-site footprints.

attributes.label: Holder field
attributes.requirement: Availability of the holder associated with each right and its access conditions; the atlas describes the source rather than reproducing holder names.

attributes.label: Commodity
attributes.requirement: Mineral/commodity covered by each right, distinguished from actual extraction.

attributes.label: Right status
attributes.requirement: Published legal/administrative state of each right, distinguished from whether a mine is operating.

attributes.label: Right dates
attributes.requirement: Published grant, validity/expiry and other relevant dates, each labelled by meaning; identify missing date components.

topics.question: Where can I get the boundaries (geometry) of protected natural areas in {country}, at every designation level (international, national and regional), with category and designation date?

attributes.label: Protected-area boundaries
attributes.requirement: Polygon boundaries of designated protected natural areas, with positional and coverage limits stated.

attributes.label: Designation levels
attributes.requirement: Coverage of international, national and regional designation levels, with omissions explicit.

attributes.label: Protection category
attributes.requirement: Published protection category/designation associated with each area, preserving the legal classification.

attributes.label: Designation date
attributes.requirement: Date/year of designation associated with the area/category; source update date alone is different.

topics.question: Where can I get the official zoning that classifies land for renewable energy siting in {country}, such as environmental sensitivity maps or renewables acceleration areas, as geometry, with category and the technologies it applies to?

attributes.label: Zoning geometry
attributes.requirement: Geometry of official siting/sensitivity/acceleration zones, distinguished from map images or unclassified resource surfaces.

attributes.label: Zone category
attributes.requirement: Official siting classification associated with each zone, with its published meaning and effect stated.

attributes.label: Applicable technologies
attributes.requirement: Technologies to which the zone/classification applies; solar/wind classifications are not automatically interchangeable.

topics.question: Where can I get flood hazard zones (geometry) in {country}, with return period or probability and the issuing authority?

attributes.label: Flood-hazard geometry
attributes.requirement: Geometry of flood hazard zones and their covered flood processes, with map-only access distinguished.

attributes.label: Probability or return period
attributes.requirement: Published probability/return period associated with each hazard zone, preserving its original definition and units.

attributes.label: Issuing authority
attributes.requirement: Authority issuing the hazard zoning, including territorial competence where relevant.

topics.question: Where can I get the areas designated to protect sensitive species in {country}, such as bird protection zones for power lines or species recovery plan areas, as geometry, with species and legal effect?

attributes.label: Designated-area geometry
attributes.requirement: Geometry of species-protection, recovery or equivalent designated areas, not merely species observations.

attributes.label: Species
attributes.requirement: Species or specified taxonomic groups associated with each designated area.

attributes.label: Legal effect
attributes.requirement: Published legal effect/restrictions of the designation with its supporting instrument; a species presence record alone is insufficient.

topics.question: Where can I get the locations or boundaries of protected cultural heritage and archaeological sites in {country}, with protection category and the authority that holds the register?

attributes.label: Heritage-site location
attributes.requirement: Published location of identifiable protected sites, preserving coarse or withheld precision.

attributes.label: Heritage-site boundaries
attributes.requirement: Published boundaries of protected sites, distinguished from buffer/setting areas where relevant.

attributes.label: Protection category
attributes.requirement: Protection/listing category associated with each site under its register.

attributes.label: Register authority
attributes.requirement: Authority holding the relevant heritage/archaeological register and its territorial scope.

topics.question: Where can I get the register of water abstraction rights and concessions in {country}, with location, holder, use, authorised volume and status?

attributes.label: Right or abstraction location
attributes.requirement: Published abstraction/right location, distinguishing intake points, authorised areas and municipality-only references.

attributes.label: Holder field
attributes.requirement: Availability of the holder associated with each right and access conditions; do not copy holder names into the atlas.

attributes.label: Authorised use
attributes.requirement: Published authorised use associated with the abstraction right/concession.

attributes.label: Authorised volume
attributes.requirement: Authorised abstraction volume with units and time basis; instantaneous flow or actual extraction must remain distinguished.

attributes.label: Right status
attributes.requirement: Published legal/administrative status per right/concession; a historical grant alone does not establish current validity.

topics.question: How can I find out who owns a given land parcel in {country}: which register holds ownership, whether it is open, and the legal route and cost to obtain it?

attributes.label: Ownership register
attributes.requirement: Register holding parcel ownership and the territorial route to identify the competent register.

attributes.label: Whether access is open
attributes.requirement: Documented openness, access restrictions and eligibility; a verified restricted register fully answers the access question.

attributes.label: Legal access route
attributes.requirement: Documented lawful request/consultation procedure, required parcel identifiers and applicable conditions without claiming untested access.

attributes.label: Access cost
attributes.requirement: Published fee/cost or an explicit free-access statement, with the priced service and date stated; unknown cost is not zero.

topics.question: Where can I get agricultural parcels (geometry) in {country}, with declared crop or land use and irrigation, by year?

attributes.label: Agricultural parcel geometry
attributes.requirement: Geometry of declared agricultural parcels/fields with the published record unit and territorial coverage.

attributes.label: Declared crop or land use
attributes.requirement: Declared crop or agricultural land use associated with parcels and its published classification.

attributes.label: Irrigation
attributes.requirement: Published irrigation state/category associated with parcels; distinguish actual irrigation from irrigation eligibility or infrastructure potential.

attributes.label: Reference year
attributes.requirement: Declaration/campaign year associated with parcel geometry and attributes.

topics.question: Where can I get a list of large industrial facilities in {country}, with location, sector, operator and annual emissions by pollutant, including CO2?

attributes.label: Facility location
attributes.requirement: Location per identifiable large industrial facility, with registration thresholds and precision stated.

attributes.label: Industry sector
attributes.requirement: Published industry/activity classification associated with the facility.

attributes.label: Operator
attributes.requirement: Operator associated with the emitting facility, distinguished from corporate headquarters.

attributes.label: Annual emissions by pollutant
attributes.requirement: Published facility-level emissions by pollutant, including CO2, with year, units and thresholds; CO2-equivalent and CO2 must remain distinguished.

topics.question: Where can I get the public grants awarded to energy projects in {country}, with beneficiary, project, amount, programme, location and date?

attributes.label: Beneficiary field
attributes.requirement: Availability of the awarded beneficiary and its link to the grant/project; describe source fields without reproducing holder names.

attributes.label: Funded project
attributes.requirement: Identifiable energy project associated with each award, distinguished from a programme-only allocation.

attributes.label: Award amount
attributes.requirement: Awarded grant amount with currency and award/payment distinction; programme budget alone is insufficient.

attributes.label: Programme
attributes.requirement: Grant programme/call associated with each award.

attributes.label: Project location
attributes.requirement: Published funded-project location with precision stated, distinguished from beneficiary headquarters.

attributes.label: Award date
attributes.requirement: Date of the award/decision, distinguished from application, payment and publication dates.

topics.question: Where can I get annual agricultural crop production statistics in {country}, by crop and territory, with production volume, crop area, yield and historical series?

attributes.label: Crop
attributes.requirement: Crop name and published code or classification; distinguish harvested products from processed products.

attributes.label: Reporting territory
attributes.requirement: Geographic level and published names or codes for which the source reports the measures.

attributes.label: Reference period and historical series
attributes.requirement: Reporting year or crop season, accessible editions, comparability limits and provisional or final status.

attributes.label: Production volume
attributes.requirement: Annual production quantity and published unit for the crop and territory.

attributes.label: Crop area
attributes.requirement: Area and unit; distinguish sown, cultivated, bearing and harvested area when relevant.

attributes.label: Yield
attributes.requirement: Yield, unit and area denominator; distinguish a published figure from a calculation based on compatible source data.
